pipeline: reproduce the complete v1 gated Level-0 case
reproduce the preregistered asymmetric and complex Phase-C extension
carry forward any qualified expanded branch into Phase D
stop without creating a collective when no eligible branch exists

claims.positive: Level 0 is validated only if a Phase-C branch passes every declared gate and its resulting population passes Phase D
claims.negative: the complete expanded declared model is not validated when no Phase-C branch qualifies
claims.boundary: the result applies only to the frozen v1 case plus the six-scenario, four-perturbation extension
notClaimed: validation or falsification of the general theory
coverage of all asymmetric parameters or complex perturbations
